page_title: LIV 0-1 CRY | Liverpool v Crystal Palace 14/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90+7' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
90+4' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
90+2' Liverpool can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+1' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jean-Philippe Mateta walks off the pitch to be replaced by Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace).
89' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
88' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
87' Dean Henderson makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) after a cross from the side.
86' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

85' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Liverpool in a dangerous position.
83' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle as Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
83' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
82' Jurgen Klopp has decided to substitute Curtis Jones and he is replaced by Harvey Elliott (Liverpool).
81' Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
79' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) replaces Eberechi Eze.
77' Here is a change. Nathaniel Clyne is going off and Oliver Glasner gives the last tactical orders to Joel Ward (Crystal Palace).
77' It will be a substitution. Jairo Riedewald (Crystal Palace) is ready to enter the pitch as Will Hughes walks off.
76' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) received a precise pass and hammers the ball at goal from close range. Unfortunately for him, his aim was a bit off and it flies just wide of the right post.
75' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Crystal Palace comes to nothing.

74' A pass into the box finds Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Alisson denies him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Crystal Palace will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
73' Liverpool take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

73' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Liverpool will take a corner kick.
71' The foul by Curtis Jones (Liverpool) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Chris Kavanagh.
70' A dangerous towering header by Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
70' Corner kick. Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is ready to send the ball into the box.
70' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
69' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is flagged for offside.
68' The manager makes a subsitution with Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) coming on for Michael Olise.
66' Jurgen Klopp has decided to make a change. Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) replaces Darwin Nunez.
66' Here comes a substitution. Diogo Jota (Liverpool) is brought on as a substitute for Luis Diaz.

62' That's unlucky! Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
60' A rebound falls at the feet of Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar.
60' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
57' The corner from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is intercepted by the defence.
56' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Dean Henderson.
56' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

53' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball is out of play. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner.
53' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is penalised for a foul. Chris Kavanagh had a clear view and blows his whistle.
52' Crystal Palace keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
48' Conor Bradley doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
47' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
47' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Wataru Endo leaves the pitch and Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) comes on.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) crashes a header just wide of the left post from close range after a searching cross. He should have scored!
43' Flag goes up against Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
41' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Alisson easily deals with the threat.
40' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
38' A pass from Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is intercepted by Dean Henderson and the move breaks down.

35' Dean Henderson makes a brilliant save! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the left side of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
34' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
32' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) jumps into a tackle and Chris Kavanagh signals a foul. Liverpool earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
31' The linesman signals that Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
31' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
30' Corner kick. Liverpool will have an opportunity.

29' CHANCE! Luis Diaz (Liverpool) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a sublime shot towards the right side of the goal, but Dean Henderson produces an excellent save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
28' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
27' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) looks on in disbelief after missing his chance. He fires the rebound onto the crossbar!
27' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
27' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
26' Dean Henderson displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
23' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
23' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
22' Looks like Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
21' The game is interrupted as Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is flagged offside.
20' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) was too forceful with his tackle and Chris Kavanagh interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
18' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
18' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
16' Flag up against Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
14' 0 - 1 Goal! Tyrick Mitchell tees up Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the middle of the goal. 0:1.
11' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.

8' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Dean Henderson makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
6' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Liverpool.
4' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
3' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace), but the defence gets it clear.
1' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) serves up a nice cross, but Alisson punches the ball away.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Crystal Palace will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
The referee of today's match will be Chris Kavanagh.
